mentions.title: Ever wonder what “forever chemicals” actually are? #podcast
mentions.description:

The secret to their permanence is the carbon-fluorine bond. This chemical bond is one of the strongest in organic chemistry. Because nature cannot easily break this bond apart, these chemicals build up in the environment and our bodies instead of degrading.
